39185-across-the-cameroons-a-story-of-wa.title: A Story of War and Adventure
39185-across-the-cameroons-a-story-of-wa.creator: Unknown
39185-across-the-cameroons-a-story-of-wa.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Late on a September afternoon, in the year 1913, two boys returned to Friar’s Court by way of the woods. Each carried a gun under his arm, and a well-bred Irish water-spaniel followed close upon their heels. They were of about the same age, though it would have been apparent, even to the most casual observer, that they stood to one another in the relation of master to man.

56711-poems-of-giosue-carducci-translate.title: Ii Carducci And The Classic Realism
56711-poems-of-giosue-carducci-translate.creator: Frank Sewall
56711-poems-of-giosue-carducci-translate.description: A book by Frank Sewall. In endeavouring to introduce Carducci to English readers through the following essays and translations, I would not be understood as being moved to do so alone by my high estimate of the literary merit of his poems, nor by a desire to advocate any peculiar religious or social principles which they may embody.

arxiv-2203-04713.title: Defending Black-box Skeleton-based Human Activity Classifiers
arxiv-2203-04713.creator: He Wang, Yunfeng Diao, Zichang Tan, Guodong Guo
arxiv-2203-04713.description: Abstract Skeletal motions have been heavily relied upon for human activity recognition (HAR). Recently, a universal vulnerability of skeleton-based HAR has been identified across a variety of classifiers and data, calling for mitigation. To this end, we propose the first black-box defense method for skeleton-based HAR to our best knowledge.

arxiv-2307-09588.title: Automating Wood Species Detection and Classification in Microscopic Images of Fibrous Materials with Deep Learning
arxiv-2307-09588.creator: Lars Nieradzik, Jördis Sieburg-Rockel, Stephanie Helmling, Janis Keuper, Thomas Weibel, Andrea Olbrich, Henrike Stephani
arxiv-2307-09588.description: Abstract We have developed a methodology for the systematic generation of a large image dataset of macerated wood references, which we used to generate image data for nine hardwood genera. This is the basis for a substantial approach to automate, for the first time, the identification of hardwood species in microscopic images of fibrous materials by deep learning.

arxiv-2311-07864.title: Probing clustering in neural network representations
arxiv-2311-07864.creator: Thao Nguyen, Simon Kornblith
arxiv-2311-07864.description: Abstract Neural network representations contain structure beyond what was present in the training labels. For instance, representations of images that are visually or semantically similar tend to lie closer to each other than to dissimilar images, regardless of their labels. Clustering these representations can thus provide insights into dataset properties as well as the network internals.

arxiv-2401-00627.title: Student and AI responses to physics problems examined through the lenses of sensemaking and mechanistic reasoning
arxiv-2401-00627.creator: Amogh Sirnoorkar, Dean Zollman, James T Laverty, Alejandra J Magana, Sanjay Rebello, Lynn A Bryan
arxiv-2401-00627.description: Abstract Several reports in education have called for transforming physics learning environments by promoting sensemaking of real-world scenarios in light of curricular ideas. Recent advancements in Generative-Artificial Intelligence has garnered increasing traction in educators’ community by virtue of its potential in transforming STEM learning.

arxiv-2402-10148.title: Tracer dynamics in polymer networks: generalized Langevin description
arxiv-2402-10148.creator: Sebastian Milster, Fabian Koch, Christoph Widder, Tanja Schilling, Joachim Dzubiella
arxiv-2402-10148.description: Abstract Tracer diffusion in polymer networks and hydrogels is relevant in biology and technology, while it also constitutes an interesting model process for the dynamics of molecules in fluctuating, heterogeneous soft matter. Here, we study systematically the time-dependent dynamics and (non-Markovian) memory effects of tracers in polymer networks based on (Markovian) implicit-solvent Langevin simulations.

arxiv-2404-10700.title: Rawformer: Unpaired Raw-to-Raw Translation for Learnable Camera ISPs
arxiv-2404-10700.creator: Georgy Perevozchikov, Nancy Mehta, Mahmoud Afifi, Radu Timofte
arxiv-2404-10700.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Georgy Perevozchikov, Nancy Mehta, Mahmoud Afifi, Radu Timofte. Modern smartphone camera quality heavily relies on the image signal processor (ISP) to enhance captured raw images, utilizing carefully designed modules to produce final output images encoded in a standard color space (e.g., sRGB). Neural-based end-to-end learnable ISPs offer promising advancements, potentially replacing traditional ISPs with their ability to adapt without requiring extensive tuning for each new camera model, as is often the case for nearly every module in traditional ISPs.

arxiv-2406-06341.title: Predicting Heart Activity from Speech using Data-driven and Knowledge-based features
arxiv-2406-06341.creator: Gasser Elbanna, Zohreh Mostaani, Mathew Magimai.-Doss
arxiv-2406-06341.description: Abstract Accurately predicting heart activity and other biological signals is crucial for diagnosis and monitoring. Given that speech is an outcome of multiple physiological systems, a significant body of work studied the acoustic correlates of heart activity. Recently, self-supervised models have excelled in speech-related tasks compared to traditional acoustic methods.

arxiv-2408-03656.title: Exploring the Singlino-dominated Thermal Neutralino Dark Matter in the Z 3 Z_{3} invariant NMSSM
arxiv-2408-03656.creator: Amandip De, Amit Adhikary, Rahool Kumar Barman, Biplob Bhattacherjee, Rohini M. Godbole
arxiv-2408-03656.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Amandip De, Amit Adhikary, Rahool Kumar Barman, Biplob Bhattacherjee, Rohini M. Godbole. We examine the parameter space of the Next to Minimal Supersymmetric Standard Model (NMSSM) with Singlino-dominated neutralino χ ~ 1 0 \widetilde{\chi}_{1}^{0} as the lightest supersymmetric particle (LSP).

arxiv-2501-19196.title: RaySplats: Ray Tracing based Gaussian Splatting
arxiv-2501-19196.creator: Krzysztof Byrski, Marcin Mazur, Jacek Tabor, Tadeusz Dziarmaga, Marcin Kądziołka, Dawid Baran, Przemysław Spurek
arxiv-2501-19196.description: Abstract 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) is a process that enables the direct creation of 3D objects from 2D images. This representation offers numerous advantages, including rapid training and rendering. However, a significant limitation of 3DGS is the challenge of incorporating light and shadow reflections, primarily due to the utilization of rasterization rather than ray tracing for rendering.

arxiv-2503-22358.title: Shapley Revisited: Tractable Responsibility Measures for Query Answers
arxiv-2503-22358.creator: Meghyn Bienvenu, Diego Figueira, Pierre Lafourcade
arxiv-2503-22358.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Meghyn Bienvenu, Diego Figueira, Pierre Lafourcade. The Shapley value, originating from cooperative game theory, has been employed to define responsibility measures that quantify the contributions of database facts to obtaining a given query answer. For non-numeric queries, this is done by considering a cooperative game whose players are the facts and whose wealth function assigns 1 or 0 to each subset of the database, depending on whether the query answer holds in the given subset.

arxiv-2505-24022.title: The Rich and the Simple: On the Implicit Bias of Adam and SGD
arxiv-2505-24022.creator: Bhavya Vasudeva, Jung Whan Lee, Vatsal Sharan, Mahdi Soltanolkotabi
arxiv-2505-24022.description: Abstract Adam is the de facto optimization algorithm for several deep learning applications, but an understanding of its implicit bias and how it differs from other algorithms, particularly standard first-order methods such as (stochastic) gradient descent (GD), remains limited. In practice, neural networks (NNs) trained with SGD are known to exhibit simplicity bias — a tendency to find simple solutions.

arxiv-2509-18054.title: A Knowledge Graph-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation Framework for Algorithm Selection in the Facility Layout Problem
arxiv-2509-18054.creator: Nikhil N S, Amol Dilip Joshi, Bilal Muhammed, Soban Babu
arxiv-2509-18054.description: Abstract Selecting a solution algorithm for the Facility Layout Problem (FLP), an NP-hard optimization problem with a multiobjective trade-off, is a complex task that requires deep expert knowledge. The performance of a given algorithm depends on specific problem characteristics such as its scale, objectives, and constraints.

arxiv-2509-21061.title: EnGraf-Net: Multiple Granularity Branch Network with Fine-Coarse Graft Grained for Classification Task Thanks: This is a polished version of the author’s accepted manuscript of a paper published in Computer Analysis of Images and Patterns (CAIP 2021) , Lecture Notes in Computer Science, vol. 13052.
arxiv-2509-21061.creator: Riccardo La Grassa, Ignazio Gallo, Nicola Landro
arxiv-2509-21061.description: Abstract Fine-grained classification models are designed to focus on the relevant details necessary to distinguish highly similar classes, particularly when intra-class variance is high and inter-class variance is low. Most existing models rely on part annotations—such as bounding boxes, part locations, or textual attributes—to enhance classification performance, while others employ sophisticated techniques to automatically extract attention maps.

arxiv-2512-00411.title: Theory of planar quasi-ballistic Josephson junctions
arxiv-2512-00411.creator: G.A. Bobkov, I.V. Bobkova, A.M. Bobkov, K.B. Polevoy, V. S. Stolyarov
arxiv-2512-00411.description: Abstract We develop a theoretical framework for planar quasi-ballistic Josephson junctions, where multiple superconducting leads are coupled through a large, nearly ballistic normal metal crystal. Our approach, based on quasiclassical Eilenberger equations, accounts for the dominant role of electron reflections from the crystal surfaces or single impurities, a mechanism distinct from both purely ballistic and diffusive limits.

arxiv-2601-15670.title: Geometric wavefront sets of genuine Iwahori-spherical representations
arxiv-2601-15670.creator: Fan Gao, Runze Wang
arxiv-2601-15670.description: Abstract . For Iwahori-spherical genuine representations of central covers with positive real Satake parameters, we prove the upper bound inequality for their geometric wavefront sets, formulated for general genuine representations in an earlier work by Gao–Liu–Lo–Shahidi. Meanwhile, we show the equality is attained for covers of type A A groups and for some representations of covers of the exceptional groups.

arxiv-2602-12654.title: All eigenvalues of the blowup of a graph
arxiv-2602-12654.creator: Ge Lin, Changjiang Bu
arxiv-2602-12654.description: Abstract The s s -blowup of a graph ( s ≥ 2 s\geq 2 ) is the 2 ​ s 2s -uniform hypergraph obtained by replacing each vertex with a set of size s s and preserving the adjacency relation.

arxiv-2603-05808.title: Compactifications of spaces of symmetric matrices and pointed Kontsevich spaces of isotropic Grassmannians
arxiv-2603-05808.creator: Hanlong Fang, Alex Massarenti, Xian Wu

dorian-gray-1890.title: The Picture of Dorian Gray
dorian-gray-1890.creator: Oscar Wilde
dorian-gray-1890.description: The original 13-chapter Lippincott's magazine text of Dorian Gray — rawer and more scandalous than the 1891 book; a distinct edition of a pivotal novel, transcribed from the July 1890 page scans.

pmc-12442279.title: Parental cancer: communication, daily life changes and psychosocial support: a qualitative study of adolescents and young adults who experienced parental cancer during adolescence
pmc-12442279.creator: Wiebke Geertz, Laura Inhestern, Corinna Bergelt
pmc-12442279.description: BackgroundA parent’s cancer diagnosis affects all family members. Adolescents in particular seem to be vulnerable to distress and changes associated with the cancer diagnosis. This study aims to gather information about the experiences of adolescents whose parents have cancer. We analysed communication and changes in daily life due to the parents’ illness, as well as preferences for professional psychosocial support.

pmc-12586489.title: Comparative evaluation of Olink Explore 3072 and mass spectrometry with peptide fractionation for plasma proteomics
pmc-12586489.creator: Noora Sissala, Haris Babačić, Isabelle R. Leo, Xiaofang Cao, Jenny Forshed, Lars E. Eriksson, Janne Lehtiö, Claudia Fredolini, Mikael Åberg, Maria Pernemalm
pmc-12586489.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Plasma proteomics technologies are advancing rapidly, offering new opportunities for biomarker discovery and precision medicine. Direct comparisons of available technologies are needed to understand how platform selection affects downstream findings. We compared the performance of a peptide fractionation-based mass spectrometry method (HiRIEF LC-MS/MS) and the Olink Explore 3072 proximity extension assays on 88 plasma samples, analyzing 1129 proteins with both methods. The platforms exhibited complementary proteome coverage, high precision, and concordance in estimating sex differences in protein levels.

pmc-12661300.title: Health for all? A cost-utility evaluation of Colombia's policy to enroll Venezuelan migrants (2021–2023)
pmc-12661300.creator: Oscar Espinosa, Paul Rodríguez, Valeria Bejarano, Santiago León, José Luis Ortiz
pmc-12661300.description: IntroductionFrom 2021 to 2023, Colombia implemented a national policy to expand health insurance coverage for over 1.4 million Venezuelan migrants through its subsidized health insurance system, which provides universal health coverage to low-income Colombian populations. This study evaluates the cost-utility of the intervention, focusing on its health and economic returns.

pmc-12748610.title: Effects of microalgae supplementation on performance, egg quality, yolk fatty acid levels, and blood parameters in laying hens: a meta-analysis
pmc-12748610.creator: Moh Sofi’ul Anam, Uswatun Muslykhah, Muhammad Maulana Sadid, Cuk Tri Noviandi, Andriyani Astuti, Dimas Hand Vidya Paradhipta, Ali Agus
pmc-12748610.description: Microalgae have gained attention in laying hen nutrition due to their richness in n-3 polyunsaturated fatty acids (PUFA), pigments, and antioxidants. However, their efficacy in poultry diets remains inconsistent. This meta-analysis quantitatively evaluated the effects of dietary microalgae supplementation on performance, egg quality, yolk fatty acid composition, and blood biochemistry in laying hens.

pmc-13110836.title: Experience and Preparedness of Primary Care Dentistry Residents in Dental Care Delivery to Rural Communities in South Texas
pmc-13110836.creator: Rochisha Singh Marwaha, Sohini Dhar, Suman Challa
pmc-13110836.description: ObjectivesTo assess dental residents' self‐perceived preparedness to provide dental care and their experiences delivering care in rural communities in South Texas.Materials and MethodsThis cross‐sectional study evaluates advanced education in general dentistry (AEGD, n = 19) and pediatric dentistry (PD, n = 20) residents' preparation for rural dentists and experiences providing dental care in rural South Texas.

pmc-13156504.title: Comprehensive profiling of the competitive interplay among carbamylation, glycation, and enzymatic cross-links in human bone
pmc-13156504.creator: Shoutaro Arakawa, Shota Katayama, Hikari Sugawa, Taiki Neyatani, Yu Yamashita, Daisuke Kubota, Tomohiro Kayama, Hiroteru Hayashi, Teruyuki Miyasaka, Toshiyuki Omori, Ryoji Nagai, Mitsuru Saito
pmc-13156504.description: Carbamylation-derived products (CDPs) are implicated in protein dysfunction but remain understudied in human bone. We profiled homocitrulline (HCit, the predominant CDP), advanced glycation end-products (AGEs), and enzymatic cross-links in human cancellous bone specimens (n = 211). Homocitrulline accumulated substantially, surpassing carboxymethyl-lysine. Multivariable regression identified male sex and blood urea nitrogen (BUN) as independent determinants of HCit.

pmc-13198469.title: Equine-related injuries in rural Oklahoma: a 10-year experience emphasizing genitourinary trauma
pmc-13198469.creator: James Charles, Vsevolod Shurkhay, Jianqiang Huo, Elvis Tamo, Manoj Jagadeesh, Alex Obermark, Nicholas Hollman, Zhamak Khorgami, Michael Charles
pmc-13198469.description: PurposeEquine-related injuries are a significant yet under-researched cause of trauma in rural areas, particularly in high-equine-density states like Oklahoma. This study describes patterns, severity, and outcomes of equine-related injuries over a 10-year period at a Level II trauma center, with emphasis on genitourinary (GU) trauma.

pmc-13346806.title: Blood Flow Restriction Training After Anterior Cruciate Ligament Reconstruction: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials
pmc-13346806.creator: Yuhui Hu, Long Guo, Xiaolan Zeng, Rongxia Yuan
pmc-13346806.description: Background:Anterior cruciate ligament reconstruction (ACLR) is frequently followed by significant quadriceps atrophy and strength loss due to postoperative pain and the necessity for low-load rehabilitation. Blood flow restriction (BFR) training is an emerging modality that may facilitate muscle strength and hypertrophy under low-load conditions, but its efficacy for improving functional outcomes after ACLR remains to be conclusively determined.

pmc-13395518.title: The Influence of Media Type and Posting Time on Altmetric Engagement of Orthopaedic Surgery Journals on X
pmc-13395518.creator: Firas Moussa, Thomas Leonard, Mitchell J. Christiansen, Mary K. Mulcahey
pmc-13395518.description: Introduction:Digital promotion of orthopaedic research is increasingly associated with scholarly visibility yet the influence of specific social media posting characteristics on online attention remains unclear. The Altmetric Attention Score (AAS) is a weighted score that measures the amount of attention a study has received.

pmc-13473102.title: AI-guided CRISPR screening reveals therapeutic targets in psoriasis
pmc-13473102.creator: Chenlin Zhao, Mushaine Shih, Sharif Ahmed, Steven Song, Amber Lennon, Julia M Mayes, Mengqi Jonathan Fan, Pei-Ying Lo, Jason Perera, Alanur Tutar, Andrew Kang, Elizabeth Warren, Ryan McClure, Aly A Khan, Shana O Kelley, Abdalla M Abdrabou
pmc-13473102.description: Psoriasis affects over 125 million people globally. Biologics targeting the IL-17/IL-17RA axis are effective but require systemic administration, are costly, and are unsuitable for some patients. Developing topical small-molecule alternatives requires a better understanding of how IL-17 receptor A (IL17RA) is regulated in keratinocytes, the principal effector cells of psoriatic lesions.

pmc-13589535.title: Nonoperative Management of a T1 Spinous Process Apophyseal Stress Fracture in an Adolescent Baseball Pitcher: A Case Report
pmc-13589535.creator: Yuya Fukuda, Kinshi Kato, Kenichi Otoshi, Takahiro Kaga, Yoshihiro Matsumoto
pmc-13589535.description: IntroductionOveruse-related stress injuries of the thoracic spine are uncommon among adolescent athletes, and apophyseal stress fractures in this region are particularly rare.Case PresentationWe report a rare case of an apophyseal stress fracture of the first thoracic (T1) spinous process in a 13-year-old elite baseball pitcher. The patient presented with focal upper thoracic pain without any history of trauma.
